name: @wcad/tools
//: Development tooling: fixture generation, bulk seeding, benchmarking. A real workspace package rather than loose scripts, because pnpm only links a workspace dependency into the node_modules of a package that DECLARES it. As loose files under a non-package directory, tools/*.ts had nowhere for '@wcad/geo-core' to resolve from under plain node -- it worked only under Vitest, which resolves workspace packages itself.
